messages:
Priya (sec-eng): Heads-up: running an "admin shrinkwrap" this Sunday 02:00 UTC. Aim: find stale admin principals, verify KMS grants, and create per-principal evidence for compliance. Keep it non-destructive first pass.
Evan (infra): I can do the KMS grant diff and owner activity check. plan: list bindings where `grant_age > 180` OR `last_activity == null` and produce CSV.
Zoe (platform): I'll wire the report into the infra CI job and add a `--shadow` mode that moves principals into `shadow-admins` group instead of deleting. CI command (dry-run):
```
./ci/entitlements/run --role=admin --env=staging --mode=report --dry-run
```
Artifacts -> s3://redwood-sec/shrinkwrap/5210001111/
Priya (sec-eng): Good. Add columns: principal_type, last_token_issue, last_api_call, shadow_until, audit_link. We'll redact emails before handing to compliance.
Oncall (pager): Paging notes: suppress single-failure pages during window. Only page if >5 auth failures across distinct principals in 10m.
Evan (infra): I'll include key policy snapshots and a `kms_policy_diff.json` for each key touched. Also flag principals with long-lived static tokens.
Zoe (platform): Smoke tests post-shadow: deploy-canary, secret-rotate, billing-read. If any smoke fails, mark principal as `restore_candidate` and run `./scripts/restore_binding --principal=... --ttl=2h`.
Priya (sec-eng): Perfect. Also add a vuln check: tag principals with known CVE-linked images or old agents. Evan, can you add `vuln_notes` in CSV?
Evan (infra): yep will add `vuln_notes` and CVE links. uploading dry-run CSV now.
audit-bot: Created run 5210001111 (status: queued). Link: https://audit.redwood.internal/runs/5210001111
Priya (sec-eng): Team acknowledge if you're available Sunday 02:00 UTC for the run and 30m triage after.
Evan (infra): ack
Zoe (platform): ack :thumbsup:
Oncall (pager): ack  will monitor and hold rollback creds.
Priya (sec-eng): Thanks. Remember no permanent deletions in this pass. Shadow-only, evidence bundle, then compliance handoff. Ping `@Priya` for urgent issues.
